name: XlOartVerticalOverflow
description: Specifies the vertical overflow setting for a text frame.

constants.name: xlOartVerticalOverflowOverflow
constants.description: Allow text to overflow the text frame vertically (can be from the top, bottom, or both depending on the text alignment).

constants.name: xlOartVerticalOverflowClip
constants.description: Hide text that does not fit vertically within the text frame.

constants.name: xlOartVerticalOverflowEllipsis
constants.description: Hide text that does not fit vertically within the text frame, and add an ellipsis (...) at the end of the visible text.
